d: Long, wavy, pale mint-green hair with thick curls and blunt bangs. Small, narrow eyes of a pale pinkish-red hue with a melancholic expression. A mature, youthful face with an apparent age of early adulthood. A slender build obscured by voluminous clothing. An expansive, floor-length dark navy gown featuring a high ruffled collar, oversized puffed sleeves, and a wide white tiered front panel with grey accents. Accessories include a tall, dark brown ornate candelabra holding purple candles and a small, glowing white snowflake floating above the raised left hand.
